title: Håstad soundness error
statement: For real numbers $\mathrm{noise}$ and $\varepsilon$, define the soundness error to be $\sqrt{\varepsilon}/2$ when $\varepsilon\leq\mathrm{noise}$, and $1/2$ otherwise.
